The 1:1 Lesson Room is coming

🧭 Familiar, Google-style tooling
🛡️ Safety, visible at all times
🎯 Lesson objectives built in
📎 File & worksheet uploads
🌫️ Background blur
📶 Wifi & audio checks

If you've used Google Meet, you already know how to use this. 🧭

No new tool to learn on top of everything else. The lesson room borrows the patterns you already trust: a lobby, a preview, simple controls. Then it optimises every detail for tutoring rather than meetings.

🚪 The Lobby

Check yourself before you join

Every lesson starts in a lobby. You see exactly what your student will see: camera, framing, sound. All alongside what the lesson is and when it starts. No more joining blind.

  • Live camera preview before you enter
  • "Play test sounds" so audio surprises happen here, not in the lesson
  • Clear notice that recording starts automatically, so there is no ambiguity
📶 Pre Lesson Checks

Because uni wifi is… uni wifi

We know college and university connections can be rough. So testing your setup is never buried in a menu. Mic tests, speaker tests and connection checks live right where you'd expect them, before you join.

  • Test your mic and hear yourself back
  • A test sound for your speakers, one tap and you'll hear it
  • Noise reduction to cut background chatter from halls and flats
🌫️ Background Effects

Messy room? Nobody needs to know

Tutoring from halls, a shared flat, or the kitchen table shouldn't mean broadcasting it. Blur your background or swap it entirely, including custom backgrounds if you want your own setup.

  • Three levels of blur
  • A library of tidy backgrounds made for teaching
  • Upload your own custom background
🎯 In the Lesson

Objectives and files, right beside the video

The lesson panel keeps the plan in view the whole time. Today's objectives sit alongside the call, and worksheets or revision notes can be uploaded and opened without ever leaving the room.

  • Today's objectives, tickable as you go
  • Upload worksheets, past papers and PDFs straight into the lesson
  • Everything stays attached to the lesson afterwards

Safety isn't a settings page. It's in the room. 🛡️

Our user research shows this is the top priority for parents. Students, parents and tutors should all be able to see at a glance why a Studia lesson is a safe place to be. So we put it on screen, not in the small print.

🛡️ The Safety Tab

Verification you can point at

Every lesson room carries a Safety tab showing the tutor's verified credentials and the rules of the session: DBS background check, government ID verification, and the session policies in plain language.

  • DBS background check & government ID, verified and dated (more information about this coming soon)
  • Sessions recorded for safeguarding, ending automatically on time
  • A Report button that's always one tap away
💬 Chat, Done Properly

A chat that keeps everyone protected

We offer 24/7 moderation on all chat inside the platform to ensure that you and your students are safe. It says so right at the top of the thread. Personal contact details stay out and the conversation stays about the learning.

  • Chat is built into the room, no need to swap numbers or emails
  • Clearly labelled as moderated, visible to students and parents alike
  • A record that protects tutors as much as students

That's all we can show you. For now. 🤫

The 1:1 Lesson Room is in active design right now, and you're seeing it before anyone else. Keep it between us, and start thinking about what you'd change, because we'll be asking.
